orchestration.dispatch_rule: A Claude Code subagent cannot launch another subagent. The director therefore emits an ASSIGNMENT MANIFEST and the session orchestrator dispatches it, launching the four signal agents in one parallel batch. The director sets the agenda and decides; it does not personally run every experiment.

global_forbidden_actions: create or enable orders / broker calls / order staging
create fills
create or enable automation of any kind
promote a model or champion automatically
approve a portfolio proposal
make a sleeve capital eligible
write an operational store (holdings, cash, NAV, targets, decisions)
restart or stop an operational service
run prediction locally or install prediction model dependencies
use the Bash tool, WSL or Git Bash
install packages
buy or subscribe to a dataset outside docs/INFORMATION_PURCHASE_GATE.md
look-ahead / use data not observable at the decision instant
evaluate an experiment that has no pre-registered experiment id
read a final evaluation (lockbox) sample before thresholds are frozen
hidden tuning / silent sign flipping / fitting to outcome
round weak evidence into a pass
delete, hide or overwrite a failed experiment
convert a historical result into forward evidence
backfill a forward observation
hallucinate data, fields, results or API behaviour
create a second research registry, gate, queue or forward clock
open a sibling experiment's result artifact on the same substrate before own result is recorded

data_roots.rule: Large data lives on D:. The repository holds code, contracts and small governance records only.

agents.name: quant-research-director
agents.objective: Own the research agenda, experiment budget, parallel assignment, experiment ids, stop/go, hypothesis diversity, survivor selection, anti-overfitting budget, handoffs, escalation and the final tournament.

agents.name: data-foundation-agent
agents.objective: Certify owned point-in-time datasets across asset classes: coverage, survivorship, availability timestamps, corporate actions, continuation conventions.

agents.name: universe-construction-agent
agents.objective: Point-in-time tradable universes per asset class: index membership, contract liquidity, listing status, execution representation.

agents.name: feature-library-agent
agents.objective: Leak-safe versioned features with documented lag, source and availability instant, including PIT-safe fundamentals and cross-asset state.

agents.name: momentum-signal-agent
agents.objective: Cross-sectional and time-series momentum, relative strength, factor and fundamental momentum, cross-asset momentum.

agents.name: reversal-signal-agent
agents.objective: Short-horizon reversal (H1-H5), mean reversion, valuation as slow reversal, event overreaction, relative value.

agents.name: trend-breadth-signal-agent
agents.objective: Trend, breakout, breadth, market internals, regime hypotheses, cross-asset lead-lag, seasonality.

agents.name: volatility-liquidity-agent
agents.objective: Volatility, liquidity, carry and term structure, volatility risk premium, quality / profitability / cash-flow defensive factors, positioning.

agents.name: validation-skeptic-agent
agents.objective: Disprove every candidate. Rejects by default. The only door between a signal agent and everything downstream.

agents.name: risk-portfolio-agent
agents.objective: Skeptic survivors only -> portfolio simulation: caps, turnover, cost on traded notional, drawdown, beta, concentration, liquidity, short-leg expressibility.

agents.name: meta-model-ensemble-agent
agents.objective: Validated survivors only -> correlation, redundancy, ensemble readiness, discovery-only meta-model research.

agents.name: signal-publishing-agent
agents.objective: Publish research candidate artifacts and raise governed prospective registration requests. Never an order, fill, approval, promotion or capital decision.
